A letter for you

Happy birthday, my love, my princess, my Srri ma ❤️🥹🎂. Today is one of the most special days in my life because the person who means so much to me was born today. I wish I could be beside you right now, holding your hands, looking into your eyes, and telling you how much you mean to me. You are not just my girlfriend, you are my happiness, my peace, my comfort, and the person with whom I wish to share my entire life. ❤️

I know I’m not perfect, and sometimes I make mistakes, overthink, or hurt you without meaning to, but one thing I never want you to doubt is my love for you. No matter how many misunderstandings we have, how many fights we go through, or how difficult some days become, I still want us to choose each other, understand each other, and stay together. I don’t want a love that lasts only on happy days. I want to be with you on your worst days too, when you’re sad, angry, tired, silent, or when you feel like the whole world is against you. I want to be the person you can come to without fear. 🫂

You deserve a love that makes you feel safe, valued, appreciated, and beautiful every single day. I wish I could take away every pain you’ve ever felt and replace it with a thousand reasons to smile. I wish your tears were always tears of happiness, your heart never felt lonely, and your dreams came true one by one. And whenever life gets hard, I hope you remember that you don’t have to face everything alone.

Thank you for coming into my life, for being you, for all those little moments, your silly talks, your cute anger, your smile, your way of making even an ordinary day feel special. Maybe I don’t always express it properly, but you mean more to me than I can explain through words. If I could make one wish today, it would be to see you happy, to see you achieve everything you dream of, and to be beside you while you do. ❤️

I don’t know what the future holds, but I know that whenever I imagine my happiest moments, I wish to have you in them. I want to make memories with you, laugh with you over stupid things, comfort you when you cry, celebrate every little achievement of yours, grow with you, and keep loving you through every phase of life. I want our story to be one we never give up on easily.

Happy birthday once again, my Srri ma. May God bless you with a beautiful life, good health, endless happiness, success, and everything your heart silently wishes for. You will always be someone incredibly special to me. I love you more than yesterday, and I hope I’ll have a reason to love you even more tomorrow. My love, my princess, my favourite person, and the girl I wish to keep beside me forever. ❤️🫶🏻🎀

I love you endlessly, Srri ma.

Happy birthday, my forever. 🥹❤️💍

by Sanjuu
